newsitem.title: FRANCE: Frankfurter Hypo plans French franc Pfandbriefe.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurter Hypo plans French franc Pfandbriefe.

text.p: Frankfurter Hypothekenbank Centralboden plans to issue a two-billion French franc 12-year Pfandbriefe, possibly this week, a banker at Deutsche Bank in Paris said on Monday.

The issue would would be the first ever Pfandbriefe denominated in francs and the Deutsche bank source said the the bank's strategy was partly to become more widely known by French investors ahead of European monetary union.
He said the timing of the issue, which will be jointly lead managed by Deutsche and Morgan Stanley, had yet to be fixed.
Pfandbriefe are bonds backed either by public sector-secured debt (oeffentliche Pfandbriefe) or mortgages (Hypotheken Pfandbriefe).
Hypotekenbank will be holding a presentation for investors in Paris on Tuesday. Its Pfandbriefe bonds are rated AAA by Standard & Poor's.
